instruction: Identify all cells with the first day of any month and color them yellow (#ffff00).

metadata.explanation: Task requires identifying all first-day-of-month cells (day=1) and highlighting them in yellow. Verified with Python: found 5 cells (B3, C3, D3, E3, F3) representing June 1, July 1, August 1, September 1, and October 1, 2022. Evaluator checks if all these cells have yellow fill color applied using fuzzy color matching.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Score is the proportion of first-day cells correctly highlighted: 5/5 = 1.0 (full credit), 3/5 = 0.6, etc.
